title: Render record and union diagnostics without reflection formatting
goal: Use generated record and union ToString implementations with --reflectionfree when diagnostics need field values in a trimming-conscious F# application.

selectionNotes: Use generated record and union ToString implementations with --reflectionfree when diagnostics need field values in a trimming-conscious F# application.

packageAssets: FSharp.Core lib/net10.0/FSharp.Core.dll selected for net11.0; see evidence for the exact verified package
prerequisites: Create an F# executable project targeting net11.0; set LangVersion to 11.0 and reference FSharp.Core 11.
For the canonical diagnostics project, add --reflectionfree to OtherFlags. Regional culture checks require globalization data.
Add `open System.Globalization` before the older definitions.

constraints: Contained values must also have trimming/AOT-compatible ToString implementations. This flag is not a whole-application safety certificate.

Simple output is not F# source or a serialization format: strings lack quotes, arrays can show a type name, and null-represented values can print null. StructuredFormatDisplay is not honored by simple formatting.
This contribution separately compiles and executes --reflectionfree diagnostics and ordinary scalar formatting. It does not claim a trimmed or Native AOT application publish/run.
